scoring.method: Case-author review against the fixed five-item, ten-point rubric; exact field checks corroborated by saved key.

findings: Both interfaces exposed enough evidence for both a correct ranking-fault diagnosis and a justified no-fault control conclusion.
A matching model-bound evaluation and mse<=0.01 do not enforce the declared best-candidate ranking policy.
Complete logs retained the same facts and were sufficient for this diagnosis; the comparison establishes no exclusive detection advantage.
limitations: Two agents per interface and one per case cell provide no defensible tool-effect estimate.
Agent elapsed time includes reasoning, service and tool/approval latency; it is not human investigation time.
Agents used the API client, not the graphical participant interface. Browser QA is separate.
The logs are a lossless projection of the same journal; this does not measure independent logger instrumentation effort.
Blinding relied on instructions and reported access, not an enforced per-agent filesystem capability.
The case author scored the pilot. Independent developers and blinded human scoring remain outstanding.
Candidates and validation are reused audited JAX artifacts; the new executions perform selection and local release, not training.

nextStep.action: Eligible independent developers unfamiliar with these cases complete one assigned interface/case, followed by tool-blind scoring.

apparatusReview.queryCountDefinition: Successful server evidence-query requests only; Begin, initial overview, file writes and UI gestures are excluded.
notes: The pilot native cursor was shared per case. Folded state at a target remained correct, but navigation changedKeys could reflect another session. Delivered cursors are participant-local.
Parallel pilot-03 requests retained all ten records but duplicated ordinal2. Counts use retained record count, not maximum ordinal. Delivered requests are serialized per participant.
The delivered server also withholds overview data on expired/submitted session reload and audits downloads. Late submissions remain explicitly censored timeouts.
